name: io.github.conorbronsdon/apple-podcasts-mcp
title: Apple Podcasts MCP Server
description: Apple Podcasts Connect owner analytics over Reporter: plays, followers, episodes. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PODCASTS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Reporter access token, issued by Reporter's generateToken command. Requires an Apple Podcasters Program membership. Expires 180 days after it is generated.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PODCASTS_VENDOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Reporter vendor number (digits only, e.g. 87654321), issued with an Apple Podcasters Program membership. Not the account UUID under Podcasts Connect > Account > Details.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PODCASTS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Apple account number. Only needed when the access token can read more than one account, which Reporter reports as error 214.
